paragraphs.source_en: If these comments by a great money manager, a brilliant academic, and a straight-thinking journalist don’t persuade you about the hazards of focusing on past returns of mutual funds, just believe what fund organizations tell you. Every single firm in the fund industry acknowledges my conclusion that past fund performance is of no help in projecting the future returns of mutual funds. For in every mutual fund prospectus, in every sales promotional folder, and in every mutual fund advertisement citing a fund’s investment returns (albeit often in print almost too small to read), the following warning appears: *“Past performance is no guarantee of future results.”* Believe it!
